items.defectStatement: The retryCount > 1 branch of the cleanup OR lacks an SMS method filter, allowing the SMS cron to delete email or WhatsApp reminders whose retry count exceeds one.
obligations: Restrict retry-count cleanup to SMS reminders.
Preserve deletion of SMS reminders with retryCount > 1.
Preserve the existing scheduled-date cleanup behavior.
items.notes: The method constraint must apply within this OR branch; the sibling branch's constraint does not apply here.

items.defectStatement: The outer catch increments retryCount for unrelated preparation and database exceptions as well as SMS-provider exceptions. If those increments succeed twice, affected reminders become eligible for deletion on the next cleanup despite potentially never reaching SMS scheduling.
obligations: Do not consume the retry budget for unrelated exceptions caught by the outer handler.
Preserve error logging and continuation to subsequent reminders.
Preserve successful scheduling updates and the existing falsy-result retry accounting.

items.notes: Removing the broad increment is a conservative local fix; thrown provider errors also remain uncounted. Preserving retry accounting specifically for provider exceptions requires wider changes around the scheduling call. Whole-queue deletion is conditional, and an outage preventing counter updates will not itself accumulate retries.
